about_the_game:
Operation: Gothic Serpent DLC

Experience the brutal urban warfare in Operation: Gothic Serpent DLC for Operation: Harsh Doorstop. Set in the heart of Somalia’s capital city, this expansion throws players into the chaos of Urban Guerilla Warfare—a daring mission turned desperate fight for survival.

Navigate narrow alleyways, dense marketplaces, and fortified strongholds in a fast-paced, high-intensity environment where every corner hides danger and teamwork is the only lifeline.

Key Features:

  • 🏙️ Urban Combat in Jaziira, Mogadishu:
    Engage in street-to-street fighting through a meticulously recreated cityscape, complete with rooftop vantage points, ambush alleys, and chokepoints that demand tactical awareness and coordination.

  • ⚔️ U.S. Rangers vs. Somali Militia:
    Play as elite U.S. Army Rangers, Delta Force operators, or Somali National Alliance fighters, each equipped with historically inspired weapons and gear, including CAR-15s, M60s, RPGs, and more.

Leave No Man Behind.

The Operation: Gothic Serpent DLC transforms Operation: Harsh Doorstop into a pulse-pounding experience rooted in real-world history. From tight urban skirmishes to high-stakes rescue operations, this DLC captures the chaos, camaraderie, and courage of one of the most intense military missions of the 20th century.

short_description: Purchase this DLC to get access to the entire Operation: Gothic Serpent campaign. This campaign includes a variety of new weapons, vehicles, factions, and modes set during the US-intervention of the Somalian Civil War.
